name: opencodex
install: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun install && (cd gui && bun install)

terminals.name: ocx-proxy
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun run src/cli/index.ts start --port 8899
terminals.description: opencodex proxy server on port 8899 (health at /healthz, dashboard at /).
